name: Zenith
about: I’m Chingsangamba, online as Zenith. I’m a CSE undergraduate who likes systems that touch the physical world: sensor crates that watch produce spoil, agents that tap a phone screen for you, extensions that make the web do what I want.
Most projects start as a small experiment or a tool I need. I build fast, in dark and detailed interfaces, and I enter hackathons and competitions like the Google Solution Challenge to push myself.
A lot of my work is niche and specific too what i want to learn or want to use in daily life

interests.d: ESP32-S3 boards, LoRa and 4G links, gas and VOC sensors. Hackaday-style builds.
ADB, Termux and UI-reading agents that operate Android for you.
Ollama and small local models, RAG, and LLMs wired into real tools.
Manipuri and English translation data, and regional-language interfaces.
C++, terminal graphics, ROS2 and low-level software.
Cyberpunk and blueprint themes, geometric illustration, animation.

background: Started out as a media professional
Builds for competitions and hackathons, mostly for the Indian market
now: Building PlayWriter, a Chrome extension that turns YouTube mixes into Spotify playlists
Polishing FreshRoute, perishable-goods logistics for small farmers
Update this section any time with python tools/zen.py
headline: Building small systems where software meets hardware.
